name: Chuul
summary: An aberrant crustacean that grips foes in pincers and paralyzes them with tentacles.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The chuul can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.text: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the *{ref:spell/detect-magic}* spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape {dc=14}) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles

save.targets: one creature Grappled by the chuul

actions.onFailure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.
